why: The developer-config walk was split into its own file for the mutation harness, and `hud.reachability.test.ts` skips that layer on the strength of the other file's name. If that file walks some other layer, developer-config is walked nowhere and every suite stays green. The split guard reads the file's source and requires a call naming the layer it was split for.
killedBy: every HUD layer is reachable by arrows and by a D-pad (issue #914) walks every layer, here or in the file named for it
